title: Hole Depth Prediction in a Femtosecond Laser Drilling Process Using Deep Learning.
summary: 200 laser-drilling data points, 140 train/60 test; DL predicts hole depth from process inputs; validation MAE chosen across architectures and complexity showed overfit. Exact test-error tables inspected in PDF. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
